# Skills copied from DietrichGebert/ponytail

Source: https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail, commit
`9b58c1ffb790c075ca32e70a89cf1d80588f4abf` (2026-10-10), MIT licence.

These files are unmodified copies, deployed to `~/.claude/skills/` by the
`claude` profile. Compare with upstream before changing them; re-copy at a new
commit to update.

`tracked/claude/output-styles/ponytail-adhd.md` carries an adapted copy of
these rules; update it by hand when you re-copy.

The upstream hooks, status line, commands and the other `ponytail-*` skills are not copied.

| Deployed skill | Upstream path |
| --- | --- |
| `ponytail` | `skills/ponytail/SKILL.md` |
| `ponytail-audit` | `skills/ponytail-audit/SKILL.md` |
